2119944322413998508.en_summary: Max Wiethe spoke with @jam_croissant and @NoelSmith about near term crash risk. Takeaways: neither saw a crash this week as very likely and it would need to materialize early in the week. There is a lot of hedged positioning between now and year end from $NVDA earnings, Nov Opex, December FOMC, and Dec Opex. It will be hard to crash until that is clear.
2119944322413998508.zh_summary: Max Wiethe 與 @jam_croissant 和 @NoelSmith 討論近期崩盤風險。要點：兩人均不認為本週崩盤可能性很高，且需在週初顯現。從現在到年底，因 $NVDA 財報、11月期權到期、12月FOMC及12月期權到期，有大量對衝倉位。在這些明朗前難以崩盤。
